test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The beggar was blind ________ one eye.
solution:
The correct answer is '**in**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition "**in**" is used to describe the state or condition of being blind in a specific eye.
 
• The phrase "**blind in one eye**" is a standard expression in English.
 
• **Options 2, 3**, and **4** are grammatically incorrect in this context as they do not fit the standard usage.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The beggar was blind **in**__ one eye."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "at"** is incorrect because "blind at one eye" is not a valid construction in English.
 
• **Option 3: "on"** is incorrect because "blind on one eye" is not idiomatic or standard usage.
 
• **Option 4: "by"** is incorrect because "blind by one eye" does not make logical sense in this context.
